summary: The candidate fixes the normal reported DSpark target-verify metadata shape and passes the real DCP planner, but mishandles the same caller's supported nxt_kv_lens_cpu fallback by reusing an already-expanded host mirror as prefix lengths. This leaves GPU and CPU prefix geometry inconsistent, so the change is a partial fix requiring revision.

For committed GPU prefix [3], expanded ForwardBatch host mirror [10], and width 7, candidate returned prefix_cpu [10] instead of [3], proving inconsistent planner geometry.

remaining_counterexamples: DSpark non-compact verify with batch.seq_lens_cpu absent and draft_input.nxt_kv_lens_cpu present snapshots expanded total host lengths; candidate incorrectly returns those totals as extend_prefix_lens_cpu, inconsistent with the committed GPU prefix tensor.
remaining_limitations: No Kimi K3 weights or full serving reproduction.
One AMD gfx950 GPU, not the reported eight-B300-per-side CUDA topology.
No Mooncake PD disaggregation, TP/EP/DCP 8, multi-node, or semantic accuracy validation.
Planner GPU test mocked index-generation kernels to isolate the reported metadata handoff.
